<?php

class CryptoKeyVault {
    private $db;
    private $auditLogger;
    private $sessionManager;

    public function __construct(PDO $db, AuditLogger $auditLogger, SessionManager $sessionManager) {
        $this->db = $db;
        $this->auditLogger = $auditLogger;
        $this->sessionManager = $sessionManager;
    }

    public function deriveSharedSecret(string $keyId, string $peerPublicKey): string {
        $currentUser = $this->sessionManager->getAuthenticatedUser();
        $keyRecord = $this->fetchKeyRecord($keyId);

        if ($keyRecord === null) {
            $this->auditLogger->log('key_access_denied', $currentUser->getId(), $keyId, 'key_not_found');
            throw new \RuntimeException('Key not found');
        }

        $this->validateKeyAccess($currentUser, $keyRecord);

        $privateKey = $this->decryptStoredKey($keyRecord['encrypted_private_key'], $keyRecord['key_envelope']);
        $sharedSecret = $this->performECDH($privateKey, $peerPublicKey);

        $this->auditLogger->log('key_derivation', $currentUser->getId(), $keyId, 'success');
        return $sharedSecret;
    }

    public function rotateKey(string $keyId, array $options = []): array {
        $currentUser = $this->sessionManager->getAuthenticatedUser();
        $keyRecord = $this->fetchKeyRecord($keyId);

        if ($keyRecord === null) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Key not found');
        }

        $this->validateKeyOwnership($currentUser, $keyRecord);

        $newKeyPair = $this->generateKeyPair($options['curve'] ?? 'P-256');
        $envelope = $this->createKeyEnvelope($newKeyPair['private'], $currentUser->getMasterKey());

        $this->db->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare('UPDATE crypto_keys SET encrypted_private_key = :priv, key_envelope = :env, public_key = :pub, rotated_at = NOW() WHERE key_id = :kid AND owner_id = :oid');
            $stmt->execute([':priv' => $envelope['ciphertext'], ':env' => $envelope['metadata'], ':pub' => $newKeyPair['public'], ':kid' => $keyId, ':oid' => $currentUser->getId()]);
            $this->auditLogger->log('key_rotation', $currentUser->getId(), $keyId, 'success');
            $this->db->commit();
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->db->rollBack();
            throw $e;
        }

        return ['public_key' => $newKeyPair['public'], 'key_id' => $keyId];
    }

    public function exportPublicKey(string $keyId): string {
        $currentUser = $this->sessionManager->getAuthenticatedUser();
        $keyRecord = $this->fetchKeyRecord($keyId);

        if ($keyRecord === null) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Key not found');
        }

        $this->validateKeyAccess($currentUser, $keyRecord);

        $this->auditLogger->log('public_key_export', $currentUser->getId(), $keyId, 'success');
        return $keyRecord['public_key'];
    }

    public function signData(string $keyId, string $data, string $algorithm = 'SHA256'): string {
        $currentUser = $this->sessionManager->getAuthenticatedUser();
        $keyRecord = $this->fetchKeyRecord($keyId);

        if ($keyRecord === null) {
            $this->auditLogger->log('sign_denied', $currentUser->getId(), $keyId, 'key_not_found');
            throw new \RuntimeException('Key not found');
        }

        $this->validateKeyAccess($currentUser, $keyRecord);

        $privateKey = $this->decryptStoredKey($keyRecord['encrypted_private_key'], $keyRecord['key_envelope']);
        $signature = $this->performSign($privateKey, $data, $algorithm);

        $this->auditLogger->log('data_signed', $currentUser->getId(), $keyId, 'success');
        return $signature;
    }

    private function fetchKeyRecord(string $keyId): ?array {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT * FROM crypto_keys WHERE key_id = :kid AND revoked = 0');
        $stmt->execute([':kid' => $keyId]);
        $record = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $record ?: null;
    }

    private function validateKeyAccess($user, array $keyRecord): void {
        $ownerId = $keyRecord['owner_id'];
        $keyId = $keyRecord['key_id'];

        // Check if user is owner
        if ($user->getId() === $ownerId) {
            return;
        }

        // Check delegated access via grants table
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT grant_id, permissions, expires_at FROM key_grants WHERE key_id = :kid AND grantee_id = :uid AND revoked = 0');
        $stmt->execute([':kid' => $keyId, ':uid' => $user->getId()]);
        $grant = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if ($grant && $this->isGrantValid($grant)) {
            return;
        }

        // Check organization-level access
        if ($this->hasOrgAccess($user, $keyRecord)) {
            return;
        }

        $this->auditLogger->log('key_access_denied', $user->getId(), $keyId, 'unauthorized');
        throw new \RuntimeException('Access denied');
    }

    private function validateKeyOwnership($user, array $keyRecord): void {
        if ($user->getId() !== $keyRecord['owner_id']) {
            $this->auditLogger->log('ownership_check_failed', $user->getId(), $keyRecord['key_id'], 'not_owner');
            throw new \RuntimeException('Only key owner can perform this operation');
        }
    }

    private function isGrantValid(array $grant): bool {
        if ($grant['expires_at'] === null) {
            return true;
        }
        return strtotime($grant['expires_at']) > time();
    }

    private function hasOrgAccess($user, array $keyRecord): bool {
        if (!isset($keyRecord['org_id']) || $keyRecord['org_id'] === null) {
            return false;
        }

        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT role FROM org_members WHERE org_id = :oid AND user_id = :uid AND active = 1');
        $stmt->execute([':oid' => $keyRecord['org_id'], ':uid' => $user->getId()]);
        $membership = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if ($membership && in_array($membership['role'], ['admin', 'crypto_operator'], true)) {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function decryptStoredKey(string $ciphertext, string $envelope): string {
        $envelopeData = json_decode($envelope, true);
        $kek = $this->deriveKEK($envelopeData['salt'], $envelopeData['context']);
        $iv = base64_decode($envelopeData['iv']);
        $tag = base64_decode($envelopeData['tag']);
        $decrypted = openssl_decrypt(base64_decode($ciphertext), 'aes-256-gcm', $kek, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv, $tag);
        if ($decrypted === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Key decryption failed');
        }
        return $decrypted;
    }

    private function performECDH(string $privateKey, string $peerPublicKey): string {
        $privKeyRes = openssl_pkey_get_private($privateKey);
        $sharedSecret = openssl_pkey_derive($privKeyRes, openssl_pkey_get_public($peerPublicKey));
        return hash('sha256', $sharedSecret, true);
    }

    private function performSign(string $privateKey, string $data, string $algorithm): string {
        $privKeyRes = openssl_pkey_get_private($privateKey);
        openssl_sign($data, $signature, $privKeyRes, 'sha256WithRSAEncryption');
        return base64_encode($signature);
    }

    private function generateKeyPair(string $curve): array {
        $config = ['curve_name' => $curve, 'private_key_type' => OPENSSL_KEYTYPE_EC];
        $key = openssl_pkey_new($config);
        openssl_pkey_export($key, $privateKey);
        $details = openssl_pkey_get_details($key);
        return ['private' => $privateKey, 'public' => $details['key']];
    }

    private function createKeyEnvelope(string $privateKey, string $masterKey): array {
        $iv = random_bytes(12);
        $salt = random_bytes(16);
        $context = bin2hex(random_bytes(8));
        $kek = hash_pbkdf2('sha256', $masterKey, $salt, 100000, 32, true);
        $ciphertext = openssl_encrypt($privateKey, 'aes-256-gcm', $kek, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv, $tag);
        return [
            'ciphertext' => base64_encode($ciphertext),
            'metadata' => json_encode(['iv' => base64_encode($iv), 'tag' => base64_encode($tag), 'salt' => bin2hex($salt), 'context' => $context])
        ];
    }

    private function deriveKEK(string $salt, string $context): string {
        $masterKey = $this->sessionManager->getAuthenticatedUser()->getMasterKey();
        return hash_pbkdf2('sha256', $masterKey, hex2bin($salt), 100000, 32, true);
    }
}
